A Visual Record

Quiet glimpses of the shrine.

The reborn temple of 2026, the new sanctum, and the deity, before and after.

The reborn shrine in stone: its twenty-seven-pillar mandapam, one pillar to each nakshatra, where the priests perform Nakshatra Dosha Parihara at the pillar of your birth-star.

Visit the Devasthanam

Rampura village, Srirangapatna Taluk, Mandya District, Karnataka – 571427. Open all days, 5:30 AM – 8:30 PM. Free entry, direct auto-taxi from Srirangapatna (8 km) and Mysuru (22 km).

Kubera Anjaneyaswamy

An ancient kshetra on the banks of the Cauvery, near Mysuru and Srirangapatna, said to be one of the 1,008 Hanumans consecrated by Sri Vyasaraja.
